recipe.visualDefinition: A 1960s-style square album cover featuring a central film-grain portrait framed by a thick orange border, topped with a heavy slab-serif header and accented by a warped psychedelic heart graphic.
coreVisualRelationships: Bold orange framing containing a muted, desaturated portrait
Heavyweight top-aligned typography contrasting with a small, organic heart shape
Vertical branch element in the foreground breaking the portrait's symmetry
High-contrast dark blue header bar against vibrant orange outlines
coreInvariants: Thick orange outer border with rounded corners
Secondary text contained within a heart-shaped silhouette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up portrait centered horizontally, slightly cropped at the bottom, occupying 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The heavy slab-serif name in the top dark blue bar.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top header, moves down to the subject's face, follows the vertical branch on the left, and settles on the heart graphic on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Muted, out-of-focus background behind the subject provides breathing room for the foreground elements.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic frame elements versus low saturation and medium value in the photographic center.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Ultra-bold slab serif and psychedelic liquid lettering
letterConstructionRules: Header: Massive, thick strokes with minimal counters and heavy horizontal slabs.
Heart Graphic: Letters warped to fit a circular/heart contour with varying baseline curves.
characterSpecificRedesigns: G and R characters in header have extremely tight apertures.
Heart text features liquid-style distortion typical of late 60s poster art.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Structural slab serif for authority paired with fluid, hand-drawn lettering for emotional tone.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Stymie Black or Rockwell Extra Bold
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif header weight and structure.
Provides the soft, rounded foundation for the psychedelic heart text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A square film-grain photo of a man in a beige suit looking down, holding a weathered wooden branch on the left. Surround the photo with a thick orange border that has rounded corners. Include a dark blue rectangular bar at the very top inside the orange frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-bold slab serif text in orange inside the top blue bar. Add a small orange heart graphic in the upper right of the photo area containing navy blue liquid-style warped lettering.

verificationChecks: Is the outer border orange with rounded corners?
Is the header text a heavy slab serif?
Is the secondary text warped into a heart shape?
Does the photo have a vintage film grain texture?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Record label logos in the top right corner
Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the orange color is vibrant but not neon.
Verify the slab serif text is legible despite its extreme weight.
Check that the branch element doesn't obscure the subject's face.
Confirm the heart graphic feels integrated into the 60s style.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a thick [Color A] rounded frame with a [Color B] header bar containing [Heavy Slab Font]. Place a [Muted Film Photo] in the center and accent with a [Warped Shape Graphic] containing [Liquid Lettering].
